name: Sarah Borski
title: Founder and Club Director
label: Leadership
bio:
Sarah founded Happy Valley Volleyball Club in 2023 with a vision to give local athletes more opportunities to learn, compete, and belong. As HVVC enters its fourth season, she leads its competitive teams, Academy, and developmental programs, working to make quality training accessible through year round opportunities and scholarships.

Sarah’s volleyball journey began in sixth grade. She played seven seasons with Nike NW Juniors and helped Gresham High School win back to back 4A OSAA State Championships in 2001 and 2002. After graduating in 2003, she attended Boise State University on a full athletic scholarship.

Coaching her daughter’s recreational team in 2016 brought Sarah back to the sport and planted the seed for HVVC. She now has more than 10 years of coaching experience across recreational and competitive volleyball. Outside the gym, Sarah works as a Director of Marketing, experience she brings to building connections among HVVC’s athletes, families, coaches, and community partners.

As a mother of three, Sarah understands how much a positive team experience can mean to a family. She strives to make HVVC a place where athletes build skills and confidence, form lasting friendships, and discover what they’re capable of.
